answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 44265 Country: India Title: Someone has told me that the salah which is performed wearing underwear (knickers) is not accepted by Allah. Question: My concern is about salah. Someone has told me that the salah which is performed wearing underwear (knickers) is not accepted by Allah. And our sound of Assalamualiakum should be after our Imam otherwise salah will not be accepted (in attahiyat position). So please get me clear this issue. Answer ID: 44265 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 442/417/N=1434) (1) If lungi or pyjama is worn above underwear then it is lawful to offer salah with it without any doubt and that salah shall be valid provided no other thing is found which prevents salah from being acceptable. (2) It is also not correct. If the muqtadi turns for salam after sitting equal to reciting tashahhud then too his fardh of salah shall be valid. However, it is makrooh tahrimi to do so without any excuse. The muqtadi should turn for salam along with the Imam. It is said in Rud al-Muhtar (Vol. 2, p. 240 published by Maktaba Zakariya Deoband): قوله: "ولو أتمه الخ" : أي : لو أتم المؤتم التشهد بأن أسرع فيه وفرغ منه قبل إتمام إمامه فأتى بما يخرجه من الصلاة كسلام أو كلام أو قيام جاز أي : صحت صلاته لحصوله بعد تمام الأركان لأن الإمام وإن لم يكن أتم التشهد لكنه قعد قدره ....... اهـ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
